parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch or handle of the faucet, made of stainless steel, small in size, and cylindrical in shape.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the water flow and temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt to adjust the water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body or frame of the faucet, made of stainless steel, cylindrical and sturdy.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the spout and switch, connects to the water supply, and houses internal valves.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet, made of stainless steel, curved and tubular in shape.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water flow from the faucet to the sink.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally to direct water to different areas of the sink.
